title: Pointed partition posets have an explicit EW-labeling and a Whitney dual
author: González D’León, Rafael S.; Hallam, Joshua; Quiceno D., Yeison A.
work: Whitney twins, Whitney duals, and operadic partition posets

primary_locator.required_core: exact pointed partition/label posets and merge conventions, label-preserving upper-filter isomorphism, unique increasing-chain shuffle proof, injectivity and rank-two switching interval diagram

difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a label-preserving upper-filter isomorphism, proves unique increasing chains in arbitrary intervals via controlled label shuffles, and verifies rank-two switching using the complete interval diagram. These compatible global properties establish a nonroutine Whitney-dual construction rather than a definition-only labeling check.
